evidence.title: If I Had a Million
evidence.text: If I Had a Million is a 1932 American pre-Code Paramount Studios anthology film.

evidence.title: If I Had a Million
evidence.text: There were seven directors: Ernst Lubitsch, Norman Taurog, Stephen Roberts, Norman Z. McLeod, James Cruze, William A. Seiter, and H. Bruce Humberstone.

evidence.title: If I Had a Million
evidence.text: Lubitsch, Cruze, Seiter, and Humberstone were each responsible for a single vignette, Roberts and McLeod directed two each, and Taurog was in charge of the prologue and epilogue.

evidence.title: If I Had a Million
evidence.text: The screenplays were scripted by many different writers, with Joseph L. Mankiewicz making a large contribution.

evidence.title: If I Had a Million
evidence.text: "If I Had a Million" is based on a novel by Robert Hardy Andrews.

evidence.title: Neil LaBute
evidence.text: Neil N. LaBute (born March 19, 1963) is an American film director, screenwriter, playwright and actor.

evidence.title: Neil LaBute
evidence.text: He is best-known for a play that he wrote and later turned into a film, "In the Company of Men" (1997), which won awards from the Sundance Film Festival, the Independent Spirit Awards, and the New York Film Critics Circle.

evidence.title: Neil LaBute
evidence.text: He wrote and directed the films "Possession" (2002) (based on the A.S. Byatt novel), "The Shape of Things" (2003) (based on his play of the same name), "The Wicker Man" (2006), "Some Velvet Morning" (2013), and "Dirty Weekend" (2015).

evidence.title: Neil LaBute
evidence.text: He directed the films "Nurse Betty" (2000), "Lakeview Terrace" (2008), and "Death at a Funeral" (2010).

evidence.title: Neil LaBute
evidence.text: LaBute created the TV series "Billy & Billie", writing and directing all of the episodes and is also creator of "Van Helsing".

evidence.title: Neil LaBute
evidence.text: He also directed several episodes for shows such as "Hell on Wheels" and "Billions".

evidence.title: Some Girl(s) (film)
evidence.text: Some Girl(s) is a 2013 American comedy film directed by Daisy von Scherler Mayer and written by Neil LaBute.

evidence.title: Some Girl(s) (film)
evidence.text: It is based on the play of the same name, also written by LaBute.

evidence.title: Some Girl(s) (film)
evidence.text: The film stars Adam Brody, Kristen Bell, Zoe Kazan, Mía Maestro, Jennifer Morrison and Emily Watson.

evidence.title: Some Girl(s) (film)

evidence.title: Tarzan and the Lost Safari
evidence.text: The movie was directed by H. Bruce Humberstone, and was the first Tarzan movie released in color, Eastman Color.

evidence.title: Tarzan and the Lost Safari

evidence.text: In the Company of Men is a 1997 Canadian/American black comedy written and directed by Neil LaBute and starring Aaron Eckhart, Matt Malloy, and Stacy Edwards.

evidence.title: In the Company of Men
evidence.text: The film, which was adapted from a play written by LaBute, and served as his feature film debut, won him the Independent Spirit Award for Best First Screenplay.
